message:
release: 0.2.149 -- a copy here changes nothing remote until Ctrl+V in the GNLink window

PC only. Copying on this PC (text, image, files) no longer changes the remote PC's clipboard. Ctrl+V or
Shift+Insert in the GNLink window sends what is on this PC's clipboard then, and the paste key goes only
after the remote PC says it is on its clipboard; a failure or time-out sends no key and shows a line with
Retry. A copy made on the remote PC (Ctrl+C there) is still pasted there as before. Remote -> this PC is
unchanged. Both PCs need 0.2.149; an older remote PC shows "update needed" and gets no key
(paste-on-demand t-y4wj64jw r2/r3, 64c042a + test fd03819; wire msg 80/81, Pong 0x1000).
Verified: verifier's independent build -- pure 14, paste e2e 10/10 at fd03819 (103/0), clip_bar 0/66,
release_all 0/35, xbutton 0/39, file_copy_helper 0/149, file_copy_net 0/325, clip_image 4/4; main
integration build-integ 18 tests exit 0. Codex was not on the bus; the user chose to release without its
review. Not verified: two real PCs, the elevated host's helper path, the host-IME physical-key path.

Product: version only (PC 0.2.148 -> 0.2.149; APK stays 0.2.26). Test: none. Docs: none.
